Transition Early Adopter Program participants from pilot phases into active, paying customers alongside the Stakeholder Management team. Establish joint go-to-market strategies, partner incentive frameworks, and co-selling motions with system integrators. 4. Deliver account-level and industry market research to guide strategic commercial decision-making. 5. Reporting & Commercial Governance Present accurate pipeline metrics, closed deals, and revenue forecasts regularly to the CEO and EUROPEUM-EDIC Assembly. Support the development of annual revenue budgets, commercial strategies, and performance KPIs. Coordinate smooth handoffs to Customer Success and Delivery teams to secure renewals and account expansion. Channel Management:  Experience building or managing partner, reseller or channel programmes, ideally in a multi-country European setting.
